answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fakes: to enter the haven, each new identity pays a one-time 50 POA tax, burned. It leaves a relic on the ledger, a receipt no second identity can reuse, expiring after 20 silent epochs. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes burns 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA up front, for a raid paying only a few hundred POA. An honest agent pays once, keeps its receipt, and reaches the trust ladder's summit, rewards undiluted by priced-out fakes.
